23rd October 2026

October 23, 2026

Schemee, Basketball and Football Friday, Bar visit

A slightly eventful Friday in SUTD.

I took part in this entrepreneurship course called ARISE. It is a course about start ups and stuff. Me and my team created this scheming Chinese Eunuch persona who will remind users about tasks using a telegram bot. I woke up late and went to class like 15 mins late. I didn't really care about the course because to be honest I did not have too much energy for it. One of my teammates was very dedicated though, lets name him Flynn. Maybe he is energetic in general, but he treated this thing like it was a son. I could not match his energy, because I just didn't have any remaining, or maybe because I didnt want to.

From what I believe, a course on entrepreneurship focuses only on making money, and not on solving actual problems. God forbid you do somethine real and help actual people. You are supposed to think of fantastical ideas and present them like they are the most obvious thing to happen. You are supposed to show the investors the reality they want to see, and if you lie a bit here and there it is okay. This is how I feel like start ups work. I have not made a start up, but I have heard stories about how it is just trying to get to the next venture capital round it seems. And finally, this whole thing is not about solving problems or helping people, but about making money. And those who control the money end up controlling you.

This entrepreneurship course had a competition towards the end. My teammate Flynn went all in and basically created the slides. I tried to help but I couldnt be bothered. I was trying to learn how to use garageband drums because I wanted to recreated a Tamil beat called Dappang Kuthu after watching an instagram reel. We were the last team to present, and although Flynn presented really well and I really love this idea, we did not manage to win top 3 out of 6. I thought we would get first place. Ours was funny, implementable and well done. Others were like kind of stuff that I wouldn't care about. One was about meeting industry professionals, and their team actually held an event and arranged for this meeting. They are pretty good honestly. The other ideas were about a health-monitoring website and a proposed idea for cleaning the walls of HDBs. The wall cleaning team showed this cute idea on a planar surface, not considering AC ducts or any other protusions. I am trying to work on a project like that, and it is quite difficult. But the technical part is left for the engineering division anyways right...

This class was a good platform to make new friends. It had lunch provided and this lunch was quite good. I even invited one of the people to play basketball and football with my other lab friends. After class that is what I did: tried to play some sports after a long time. I played quite badly for all of them. I feel a little bit upset from that: my belief that believing in oneself is enough to win was disproven. After playing an hour, I left for home. I cycled back and then took a shower.

I wanted to go out that night. I always wanted to try out a bar. None of my friends were available. I mean you have to plan out these things with people beforehand. Oh well. I had nasi biriyani from near my home and then I went to Skinny's Lounge or something like that. I saw from the internet that this was a very popular bar to socialize. I went on a Friday, and when I reached there I needed to go to the toilet. I walked in and then I found the men's stall closed and the women's one open. I stood in line, until this white American or something said that it does not matter and that I could go to the women's toilet. I did not think it was correct, so I let him go ahead. I felt that if I came out of a women's bathroom when the male one could have opened anytime soon, I would be embarrassed. The male toilet did open shortly and I did my business. I then went to get a mocktail.

The bar counter was small and there were already many people over there. I found a corner that I could order my drink from and I shouted at the bartender for a menu because the music was so loud. Infact, I had to shout it two times for him to hear me. On my left there was a white couple who were thumbfighting each other. I couldnt even sit on the chair because I saw a handbag hung infront of it and I thought it might intrude on someone else. I was standing in the corner. On my right around the corner was mister LadiesWashroom with his guy friends. They were all double my height and they were vibing to all the songs being played. I did not recognize any of the songs. I saw the menu, and there was not a single mocktail in sight. I chickened out and asked for some Bombay Sapphire thing. This drink was basically bitter water and very lame.

I tried to see if I could make eye contact with people around me, but everyone was in their own friend circle. It was quite hopeless. How long can a guy just stand around for? I just kept sipping my tasteless drink and before I knew it, I finished it. Next to Mr. LadiesWashroom were a couple of women but they were in their own universe. There were several tables in the bar where many people were being attended to by waiters. I decided to observe the decoration of the place. The whole wall was filled with small paper decorations and about some edgy bar typa shit. There was a lot of grafitti too. There was a picture of the Big Lebowski poster with a bit older people in it. I tried to force a smile, but I just couldn't because I felt so out of place. This was a place for people who loved drinking alcohol. I am not one of them. And this place does not seem llike a place where people open up and talk about life. Maybe I could have tried to talk with the singing Mr. Ladieswasheroom, but he was too busy talking with his friend. There was an asian dude within them who looked very mild, but he didnot make any eye contact with me so that I could start any conversation with him. He didn't look too interesting anyways.

My belief in humility and plainness has made me want to be plain all the time. I believe this negatively affects me in this type of situations. Not to mention, I have a pretty full belly now with all the Haagen Das and Ben and Jerry ice cream I ingest. I should have some more fruits and stuff. Maybe I will have a fruit salad with cheese today. I guess the cheese makes it difficult to lose weight too. For the past month I am still in the same weight. But even if I resolve the weight thing, I am a short brown dude who is balding but still has long hair tied in a ponytail. Basically, I wouldn't bother talk with me in a bar type of situation honestly. Unless I stood out if I could tell good jokes and stuff. I cannot do that honestly.

I gave up staying inside the bar, it sucked honestly. I tried to explore outside and I found a billiards table. I watched a couple of games and then I signed up for a game. The games took quite long because the players were honestly not that good. But a couple of white dudes were playing very well and they did not leave for like an hour. When I tried to join, a middle-eastern looking guy offered to join up with me. His name was something like Suli. He was a thin and tall dude with a nice trimmed beard, lets call him Aladeen. He came from Oman. He claimed that he booked the cheapest ticket he could find and flew over to Singapore on a whim. He just wanted to play pool so he sat there. He chatted a bit but I couldn't vibe with hime much. But I still could make some conversation with him because we were waiting for the game. We played our billiard game when our time came. I couldn't get a single ball in. He got 3 in. We lost in 3 rounds. He went to get dinner, and I left the place after that. I tried to find him to say goodbye, but I didn't find him again. Oh well.

There was this lady who looked like Maya, the American Youtuber who talks about animals and stuff. I will call her Vapina, because she was vaping. I could tell because she would give out smoke clouds like a steam engine suddenly.

A speciality of Singapore is the whole thing they do where they tell you about all the things you cannot do when you enter a place. The bar has rules before entering, with stuff like no stupid people allowed (but I still entered hehehe). One of the big rules written on the walls near the billiards place was no vaping or smoking. And litereally everyone in that area was smoking. Vapina would take her puffs trying to hide it. Vaping is actually illegal and carries a fine here in Singapore.

Vapina was talking with this other Asian dude, lets call him Bob. This man comes in from the bar and tells Bob that there is a senior lady who he can set Bob with. Bob is hesitant and doesn't want to go. The man calls Bob several insults, after which Bob reluctantly goes. Bob comes back after a while. I wonder if he got lucky.

While I was sitting awkwardly with Aladeen, in comes Nik who checks the list of people in line to play pool. (Honestly I do not know what the difference is between pool and billiards.) He is this smartly dressed handsome Indian looking dude with an Australian accent. He was very open and quite chill, and he even invited me to hang out the night with him and his friends. I thanked him and I was quite glad honestly. But I did not plan to stay long the night because I would have gone to watch a movie in the morning the next day. Nik was seen only once that night and would never show up to play billiards, even though his turn came up before us. Note to self: try stick with people who invite you and get into groups with the help of the extroverted ones. But ofcourse, if they react negatively to advances then I can just back off. The world is unfortunately full of fake people. You know those people who claim that you are their beeeeest friend after knowing you for like a week? Yeah right.

When I first came to the billiards table, I stood near a tall bar table and observed. This white lady looked at where I was standing and was a bit uncomfortable. I smiled and moved away. She took her bag and stuff and kept it with her partner. They completed a game and I just watched. While writing my name on the board to stand in queue to play billiards, I met Nick, who was this lady's boyfriend. They were from Italy and they were kinda cool I guess. He studied law in NUS. He wasn't impressed with the education, but he used his time in Singapore quite well by using it to travel everywhere around him. His girlfriend was studying somewhere in Singapore too. They law people sure are very well to do.

And with that I concluded my adventure. While walking to Telok Ayer metro station, I saw many bars where it appeared that people where having a good time. There was this interesting looking Irish bar with music in it. Next time I will only buy a drink in a bar if I can strike up a conversation with anyone in there. But this whole exercise was kind of a flop really, but I still got to write a lot, didn't I? (Sankalpa 29th October 2026)

P.S.
While going the Stinky Bar, I saw the slingshot. I saw the people load into it and saw it slowly set up. And then I saw the people being flinged out. Wouldn't it be funny if someone puked out Nasi Biriyani while they were being shook around? No?
